verdict.rationale: The SDK has a public first-party GitHub repository (anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python) whose README content is quoted, so at least the Python SDK source appears readable. Nothing in the pack names a license, and the SDK bundles the Claude Code CLI binary, whose source is not shown. missing for 10: any stated open-source license, evidence that the TypeScript SDK source is public, evidence that the bundled Claude Code CLI source is readable, and independent confirmation of openness.
